```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
Control_Y1 <- read.csv("../output/Control_Y1_w_elev.csv")
```

```{r}
control_1 <- Control_Y1 %>%
  mutate (
    viable = Updated_viability_cat == 1 #set only consider category 1 as viable
    )

control_sum_1 <- control_1 %>%
  group_by (Pop, Elev_m) %>%
  summarise (
    trials = n(), #count total number of tested seeds
    events = sum(viable), #count the number of viable seeds
    proportion = events / trials, #calculate the proportion of viable
    SE = sd(viable) / sqrt(n()), #calculate SE
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange (Elev_m) #order populations by ascending elevation
print(control_sum_1)

control_lm_1 <- lm( #fit linear regression model
  proportion ~ Elev_m, #test whether proportion of viable change by elevation
  data = control_sum_1 
)
print(summary(control_lm_1))

control_glm_1 <- glm( #fit binomial glm model
  viable ~ Elev_m, #model the probability that an individual seed is viable as a function of elevation
  family = binomial, 
  data = control_1
)
print(summary(control_glm_1))

control_prediction_1 <- data.frame ( #create a prediction dataset for further figure trendline creation
  Elev_m = seq ( #create a sequence of elevation values, start with lowest elevation and end at the highest elevation
    min(control_sum_1$Elev_m),
    max (control_sum_1$Elev_m),
    length.out = 100
  )
)
control_prediction_1$predicted <- predict( #calculate predicted viability for each elevation
  control_glm_1, #use fitted binomial glm
  newdata = control_prediction_1, #use predicted new elevation data
  type = "response" #return predicted viability data
)

control_figure_1 <- ggplot( #create a ggplot use population level summary data with x-axis in elevation by meter and y-axis by mean proportion of viable
  control_sum_1, aes (x = Elev_m, y = proportion) 
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + #each populations' mean proportion of viable
  geom_errorbar( #add SE bar
    aes(
      ymin= proportion - SE,
      ymax = proportion + SE
    ),
    width = 40
  ) +
  geom_line ( #add binomial glm trendline by using new prediction data
    data = control_prediction_1,
    aes (x = Elev_m, y = predicted), #plot predicted viability across elevation
    linewidth = 1, color = "red"
  ) +
  geom_text ( #add populations label at each points
    aes (label = Pop),
    vjust = -7,
    size = 3
  ) +
  theme_classic () + #use classic ggplot theme
  labs ( #add labels for x-axis and y-axis
    x = "Elevation (m)",
    y = "Proportion Viable"
  )
print (control_figure_1)
```
